title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for energy U must be correctly stated as a function of temperature and other parameters.

title: Final Heat Capacity Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for heat capacity C_V must be correctly stated as a function of temperature and other parameters.

title: Final Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for entropy sigma must be correctly stated as a function of temperature and other parameters.

title: Density of States Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the density of states D(ε) must be correctly shown, including the integration process.

title: Chemical Potential Justification
description: Important Criteria: The justification for setting the chemical potential μ = 0 in the degenerate case must be clearly explained.

title: Integral Setup
description: Important Criteria: The integral for calculating U must be correctly set up in dimensionless form.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All expressions must maintain consistent units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the final expressions.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Discussion of limiting cases or behavior as temperature approaches certain values can enhance the response.
